name: Wraith
text: Wraith is a quiet, haunted, mysterious Legend. Eerie, dark and tense, she hears voices and moves between dimensions. Her vibe is ghostly, brooding, cold and cinematic, like creeping through the shadows before a fight.

name: Octane
text: Octane is a reckless, hyperactive thrill seeker who loves speed and adrenaline. Fast, loud, cocky, funny and fearless, always rushing in headfirst with a grin. His vibe is chaotic party energy and pure adrenaline.

name: Bloodhound
text: Bloodhound is a relentless, solemn tracker and hunter. Primal, ritualistic, focused and dark, they stalk their prey with patience and then strike. The vibe is heavy, tribal, ominous and driving.

name: Lifeline
text: Lifeline is a warm, caring, heroic combat medic who protects the team and heals others. Hopeful, kind, optimistic and brave, she keeps morale up. The vibe is uplifting, bright and encouraging.

name: Mirage
text: Mirage is a charming, flashy, playful trickster and party animal who loves decoys and attention. Confident, funny, cocky and carefree. The vibe is a summer club night: groovy, bright and danceable.

name: Pathfinder
text: Pathfinder is a friendly, curious, upbeat robot who is always optimistic and excited to explore and make friends. Wholesome, bouncy, cheerful and naive. The vibe is bright, playful, electronic and fun.

name: Bangalore
text: Bangalore is a disciplined, tough professional soldier. Focused, determined, no-nonsense and loyal, she is built for sustained fights with smoke and rolling barrages. The vibe is marching, gritty, driving and militant.

name: Caustic
text: Caustic is a cold, calculating, menacing scientist who poisons whole areas with toxic gas. Sinister, methodical, unsettling and patient. The vibe is dark, slow-burning, industrial and creeping dread.

name: Gibraltar
text: Gibraltar is a big, steady, dependable protector who shields his squad. Calm, strong, loyal and reassuring, like a big brother. The vibe is warm, steady, soulful and grounded.

name: Wattson
text: Wattson is a brilliant, nervous, curious young engineer who builds electric fences and loves puzzles and science. Quirky, energetic, geeky and cheerful. The vibe is bright, electric, bubbly and nerdy.

name: Crypto
text: Crypto is a quiet, secretive, paranoid hacker who works behind screens with drones. Cold, analytical, patient and tense. The vibe is nighttime focus: pulsing, minimal, dark and cerebral.

name: Revenant
text: Revenant is a merciless, nihilistic, robotic killer who relishes the hunt and mocks his victims. Cruel, apocalyptic, dark and relentless. The vibe is brutal, hateful and heavy.

name: Loba
text: Loba is a stylish, glamorous, cunning thief who teleports and steals loot. Smooth, confident, seductive, wealthy and sly. The vibe is sleek, sultry, expensive and sophisticated.

name: Horizon
text: Horizon is a dreamy, thoughtful, wondering scientist and astronaut who is fascinated by space and time. Hopeful, curious and gentle, with a sense of awe. The vibe is cosmic, floating, spacey and emotional.

name: Fuse
text: Fuse is a loud, explosive, boisterous mercenary who loves blowing things up and fighting for fun. Rowdy, laughing, brash and fearless. The vibe is rowdy, fist-pumping, gritty and rebellious.
